title: Your connection just “moved”
scenario: After a delay, a text says you have been auto-rebooked and must confirm the new flight within eight minutes. The route and original booking reference are correct, and the link opens a convincing airline login page.

answers.A: Log in through the link because the booking reference and route prove it is tied to your reservation.
answers.B: Open the airline app or airport departure board yourself and check the rebooking there.
answers.C: Go to an airline transfer desk or gate agent and ask them to confirm the new itinerary.

explanation: Stolen itinerary data makes rebooking phishing unusually convincing. The safest move is to leave the incoming path entirely.
proTip: Correct itinerary data proves knowledge, not identity.
